free_tier.stated: Free for all users, ad-supported; as many files as you want, each under 2 GB; files may be removed after a period of inactivity.

per_object_cap.stated: Each file you upload must be less than 2 GB in size. If it is greater than that amount, your file will be rejected.

retention.stated: Files may also be removed after a period of inactivity.

egress.terms: No download allowance is printed on the FAQ.
